comments.body: By analyzing the blame information on this pull request, we identified @Morhaus, @vvo and @mthuret to be potential reviewers
I'm pretty sure I will be able to use the NumericRefinementList HOC to implemenent the numericSelector widget \o/

About the numeric selector widget, have a look at the upgrade options/ideas we have: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/841

And about all `<select>` based widgets, there's something we did not decide is that should the label be part of the default widget or not. We can discuss this elsewhere.
Owow seems like we are pretty soon gonna merge this :baby:
@mthuret once merged you will have to rebase https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/1277 unfortunately. But we won't change template engines every two weeks luckily :D
